# QuietGlobe

> QuietGlobe removes the ABC/Russian input source popup on macOS and switches keyboard layouts instantly with the Globe key. Free, open source, macOS 13+.

## What it does

- Disables the macOS input source indicator / Globe key HUD.
- Switches ABC, Russian, and other keyboard layouts instantly.
- Requires Accessibility permission for the global event tap.
- No network, no telemetry, no keystroke logging.

## Install

brew install --cask Nishikinodzuki/quietglobe/quietglobe
